faqs.question: What Shell Rimula grade is recommended for heavy-duty trucks in Oman?

faqs.question: What Castrol hydraulic oil grades are recommended for industrial machinery in Oman?
faqs.answer: For industrial hydraulic systems in Oman, Castrol Hyspin AWS 46 and Hyspin AWS 68 are the most widely specified grades, covering the majority of hydraulic pump and valve manufacturer requirements. The correct viscosity grade depends on system operating temperature: Hyspin AWS 46 (ISO VG 46) suits systems where bulk oil temperature is 40–60°C, while AWS 68 is preferred where temperatures reach 60–80°C — common in Oman's outdoor mobile equipment and unmanned process units exposed to direct sun. For systems requiring fire-resistant hydraulic fluid, Castrol Brayco 756 (phosphate ester) or Hyspin TDHF (water-glycol) are available. For mobile hydraulic systems in construction equipment, Castrol's Agri Trans Plus or equivalent multi-grade hydraulic transmission fluids provide year-round protection. Global Chemicals LLC can advise on OEM approval requirements and supply Castrol hydraulic oils in drums, IBCs, and bulk.

faqs.question: How do GP IPOL lubricants compare in quality to Shell or Mobil brands?
faqs.answer: GP IPOL lubricants meet the same API, ACEA, ISO, and OEM performance standards as premium Western brands and are manufactured under ISO 9001 certified quality management systems. The key difference is brand heritage and geographic origin: Shell, Mobil, and Castrol invest more in proprietary additive chemistry and OEM partnerships, commanding a price premium. GP IPOL uses internationally proven additive formulations from major additive companies (Lubrizol, Infineum) and manufactures to specification, delivering equivalent performance for most standard applications at 15–30% lower cost. For high-performance applications — turbocharged engines under severe duty, critical hydraulic systems with tight cleanliness requirements, or OEM-mandated approvals — premium brands may be specified. For general purpose industrial and automotive applications in Oman's manufacturing, construction, and transport sectors, GP IPOL provides reliable protection at a competitive price point. Global Chemicals LLC can provide technical comparison data for specific applications.

faqs.question: What GP IPOL hydraulic oil grades are stocked in Oman?

These ISO VG 32, 46, and 68 grades cover the complete range of industrial hydraulic systems including injection moulding machines, press brakes, CNC machining centres, lifting equipment, and mobile construction machinery. For high-temperature Oman applications, the ISO VG 68 grade is recommended where bulk oil temperatures regularly exceed 60°C in outdoor machinery. faqs.question: Can GP IPOL lubricants be used in food processing equipment in Oman?
faqs.answer: GP IPOL offers a food-grade lubricant range under its IPOL Foodsafe series, including H1-registered food machinery oils, greases, and hydraulic fluids. H1 registration by NSF International certifies that the lubricant formulation is approved for incidental food contact in food processing environments, complying with FDA 21 CFR requirements. These products are suitable for use in Oman's food and beverage manufacturing plants, fish processing facilities, bottling lines, and packaging machinery where lubricant contact with food is possible. Standard IPOL industrial lubricants are not food-grade and should not be used in food contact applications. Global Chemicals LLC supplies IPOL Foodsafe products with NSF registration documentation. For Omani food manufacturers seeking HACCP compliance, we can provide food-grade lubricant audit support and product substitution recommendations for replacing non-food-safe lubricants currently in use.
